edges.reason: msg.sender is checked against authorizedAccounts inside the isAuthorized modifier.
authorizedAccounts mapping is read using msg.sender as the key.
isAuthorized gates the address-based modifyParameters function.
isAuthorized gates the uint256-based modifyParameters function.
isAuthorized gates the relayer address-based modifyParameters.
isAuthorized gates the relayer uint256-based modifyParameters.
msg.sender becomes finalFeeReceiver when no fee receiver is supplied.
reimburseCaller requires refundRequestor == msg.sender.
rewardCaller falls back to msg.sender as the final fee receiver.
The medianizer constructor grants authorization to msg.sender.
The relayer constructor inherits authorization granted to msg.sender.
currentBlockTimestamp reads block.timestamp and truncates it to uint32.
updateResult uses now for the elapsed-time gate and for lastUpdateTime.
getMedianPrice derives timeSinceFirst from now.
getCallerReward uses now to decide the reward size.
reimburseCaller checks now minus lastReimburseTime against reimburseDelay.
updateObservations stores now as the observation timestamp.
currentCumulativePrices computes blockTimestamp - blockTimestampLast with intentional uint32 wrap.
currentCumulativePrices calls currentBlockTimestamp for the current time.
converterComputeAmountOut divides converterPriceCumulative by timeElapsed.
converterPriceCumulative is consumed to build the averaged price.
getCallerReward performs rpower/rmultiply exponential reward arithmetic.
perSecondCallerRewardIncrease feeds the reward exponentiation.
converterComputeAmountOut calls the checked multiply helper.
updateObservations calls multiply to weight the price feed value.
updateObservations calls addition for the cumulative update.
updateObservations calls subtract to remove the earliest observation.
getMedianPrice calls subtract to compute elapsed time.
reimburseCaller calls rewardCaller which performs an external fund pull.
rewardCaller performs the external treasury.pullFunds call.
treasury is the target contract of pullFunds.
updateResult performs an external call into the relayer which pulls treasury funds.
relayer state variable supplies the external call target.
updateResult calls sync on the untrusted Uniswap pair.
uniswapPair supplies the sync target.
updateResult calls updateResult on the untrusted converter feed.
converterFeed supplies the external updateResult target.
updateResult invokes updateObservations before recomputing the median.
updateResult computes the median price after storing observations.
updateObservations reads the converter feed result and validity.
converterFeed.getResultWithValidity is called from updateObservations.
updates counter is incremented and read inside updateResult.
lastUpdateTime is read to compute the first elapsed period.
read returns the stored medianPrice.
read requires updates > granularity.
read requires validityFlag == 1.
read requires the window to be below maxWindowSize.
lastReimburseTime is passed as timeOfLastUpdate to getCallerReward.
reimburseDelay is passed as defaultDelayBetweenCalls.
baseUpdateCallerReward seeds the reward computation.
maxUpdateCallerReward caps the reward.
maxRewardIncreaseDelay bounds the elapsed time used.
treasury allowance is consulted when capping the reward.
refundRequestor is compared with msg.sender in reimburseCaller.
modifyParameters(address) writes targetToken.
modifyParameters(address) writes denominationToken.
modifyParameters(address) writes converterFeed.
modifyParameters(address) writes relayer.
modifyParameters(address) derives and writes uniswapPair.
modifyParameters(uint256) writes validityFlag.
modifyParameters(uint256) writes defaultAmountIn.
modifyParameters(uint256) writes maxWindowSize.
relayer modifyParameters(address) writes treasury.
relayer modifyParameters(address) writes refundRequestor.
relayer modifyParameters(uint256) writes baseUpdateCallerReward.
relayer modifyParameters(uint256) writes maxUpdateCallerReward.
relayer modifyParameters(uint256) writes perSecondCallerRewardIncrease.
relayer modifyParameters(uint256) writes maxRewardIncreaseDelay.
relayer modifyParameters(uint256) writes reimburseDelay.
execute deploys a new IncreasingRewardRelayer.
execute deploys a new UniswapConsecutiveSlotsPriceFeedMedianizer.
execute calls modifyParameters(address) on the new TWAP.
execute calls the relayer address modifier.
execute updates treasury allowances for the new contracts.
parameter selects which state variable to modify.
data supplies the new address value.
val supplies the new uint256 value to the relayer modifier.
feeReceiver is forwarded to rewardCaller.
timeOfLastUpdate drives the elapsed-time reward computation.
defaultDelayBetweenCalls is required to earn a reward.
price0Cumulative feeds the median computation.
price1Cumulative feeds the median computation.
timeElapsedSinceLatest weights the converter feed value.
amountIn is the amount converted by converterComputeAmountOut.
account is the address granted or revoked authorization.
finalFeeReceiver is resolved and used for the payout inside updateResult.
callerReward is computed and paid out in reimburseCaller.
timeSinceFirst is used as the elapsed window in getMedianPrice.
blockTimestamp is the truncated now used for cumulative price math.
z holds the addition result and the overflow check compares it to x.
adjustedTime drives the exponential reward increase.
timeElapsed determines whether rewards accrue.
maxPossibleReward caps the computed reward.
calculatedReward holds the final reward returned.

normalization_plan.reason: account is only used to set/clear authorizedAccounts entries under the isAuthorized access control modifier.
parameter selects the branch of the address-based modification function.
data is the value written to the selected address state variable.
val is the value written to the selected reward/delay parameter.
feeReceiver is validated and forwarded to the payout routine by reimburseCaller.
timeOfLastUpdate is the primary input of the reward delay computation.
defaultDelayBetweenCalls is required before any reward can be paid.
price0Cumulative is consumed by the median price computation.
price1Cumulative is consumed by the median price computation.
timeElapsedSinceLatest weights the new converter observation in updateObservations.
amountIn is the quantity converted by the averaged converter price.
z is the local result of the checked arithmetic helpers such as addition.
finalFeeReceiver is resolved inside updateResult from msg.sender or feeReceiver.
adjustedTime is the local driving the exponential reward increase.
timeElapsed is the local that decides whether the caller is rewarded.
maxPossibleReward is the local cap derived from the treasury allowance.
calculatedReward is the local holding the final reward returned by getCallerReward.
callerReward is the local reward amount paid out by reimburseCaller.
timeSinceFirst is the local window length used in the median computation.
blockTimestamp is the local truncated timestamp used for cumulative price math.
